evals.name: registration-name
evals.prompt: Specify what the author registration handler returns for Aster.
evals.expected_output: One behavior context and a read-only observation.
assertions: Arranges RegisterAuthor with AuthorId and Aster in Establish.
Checks AuthorRegistered.Name without claiming an append.

evals.name: shared-fact
evals.prompt: A second fact clears the store to test an empty state. Refactor these specs.
evals.expected_output: Separate the second decision from observations of the first.
assertions: Creates a separate behavior context for the new action.

evals.name: spec-project
evals.prompt: Set up an isolated xUnit specification for a decision that consumes a provided value.
evals.expected_output: Use the adapter and pass typed data directly.
assertions: Lets the adapter register the framework.
Provides the typed input without claiming to test how the pipeline obtained it.
